sens_en: to turn, to change, to pass on
origine_fr: À gauche, 车, le char ; à droite, 专, qui donne le son (zhuān). Au départ, c'est transporter. La roue qui tourne : tourner, changer, transmettre.
origine_en: On the left, 车, the cart; on the right, 专, which gives the sound (zhuān). At first it meant to transport. A turning wheel: to turn, to change, to pass on.

phrase.pinyin: Zài qiánmian de lùkǒu yòu zhuǎn.
phrase.fr: Tourne à droite au prochain carrefour.
phrase.en: Turn right at the next intersection.
